見下す（みくだす）means "to look down on," "to 
condescend," or "to treat with contempt." It describes an attitude of 
superiority where one belittles others as inferior.Nuance:This term implies active disdain—unlike 無視する (to ignore), 見下す involves deliberate scorn (e.g., classism, intellectual arrogance). Always negative.Example Sentences:彼はいつも他人を見下した態度を取る。(He constantly acts condescending toward others.)学歴で人を見下すのは愚かだ。(Judging people by education is foolish.)見下すような目で見られて腹が立った。(Their patronizing glare made me furious.)Note: Often paired with ～ような (見下すような目 = "condescending gaze"). Contrast with 尊敬（そんけい, "respect").
